summary: Inna Vernikov discusses the prevalence of antisemitism at CUNY and her efforts to address it through city council oversight and advocacy. She explains the importance of adopting the IHRA definition of antisemitism to protect students and encourages the community to be vocal in demanding institutional accountability.
questions: Why is fighting antisemitism on college campuses a priority for you?
What are the legal implications of a university adopting a BDS stance?

Why is the IHRA definition important for protecting Jewish students?
